prompt: 9:16 portrait orientation, high-precision ancient Chinese xianxia style portrait of a cool and aloof female lead, Oriental fantasy period costume refined portrait, realistic character photography texture, snow-covered eave corridor scene, cold white ice and snow atmosphere. Clothing is a moon-white, ice-blue, and silver cross-collared ancient style robe + gauze cloak-style outer layer, medium-high gorgeousness. Fabrics use soft silk feel, fine embroidered gauze, translucent gauze, and light layered materials. Natural full curves are expressed through fitting but not tight overlapping lapels, waist cinching, and three-dimensional tailoring of the upper body. Multiple sets of transparent ice crystal bells, silver small bells, long ice crystal pendants, and fine chains hang under the eaves, producing fine transparent highlights when hit by cold light. Snow reflection provides bright soft cold white fill light for the face, collarbone, and lapels. Side-backlight outlines the black hair, hair ornaments, shoulder gauze, and ice bell edges, forming clear and clean hair rim lighting.
